why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Surfing Bear', a thoughtfully curated newly renovated in 2026 three-story coastal retreat professionally designed for effortless 30A living. Located in Seacrest Beach, this home offers the perfect blend of laid-back charm and elevated coastal style. Perfectly positioned just off Scenic Highway 30A and situated right next to Alys Beach, guests are steps from its iconic architecture, dining, and gathering spaces. Surfing Bear is tucked between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this prime location places you moments from world-class dining, boutique shopping, and the unmistakable charm that defines Florida’s 30A lifestyle. Inside, the home offers beautifully appointed en-suite bedrooms, each designed as a private retreat, along with a spacious bunk room on the third floor ideal for families and groups who value both connection and personal space. Spanning three thoughtfully designed levels, Surfing Bear provides generous room to spread out while maintaining a warm, cohesive atmosphere throughout. The main living spaces are crafted for gathering and relaxation after sun-filled beach days. Multiple outdoor living areas invite you to enjoy morning coffee, leisurely afternoons, or grilling and dining under the evening sky seamlessly extending the indoor living experience into the coastal breeze. Adventure is effortless from this exceptional location. With parking for four vehicles and six complimentary adult bikes, exploring the scenic bike paths and neighboring beach communities is both easy and enjoyable. A nearby tram stop offers convenient beach access through the Villas at Sunset Beach, and guests enjoy private deeded beach access along with a resort-style community pool just moments away creating the perfect balance of Gulf-front days and laid-back poolside afternoons. Whether you’re biking to dinner in Rosemary Beach, spending the day along the shore, or strolling over to Alys Beach just steps from your door, Surfing Bear offers a refined 30A escape that feels elevated, walkable, and truly unforgettable.

HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Private Deeded Beach Access -Located Just Steps to Alys Beach  -6 Adult Bikes -Private Balconies with Seating -Outdoor Dining and Sitting Areas -Smart TVs in each Bedroom -Gas Grill & Outdoor Dining -Beach Tram  -Beach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Boogie Boards, Toys & Coolers -4 Dedicated Parking Spots with Additional Parking Available Throughout the Community -Full Sized Washer & Dryer ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: King + (2) Twin Beds  -Full Bath With Walk-in Shower SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 2: King with Ensuite -Bedroom 3: King with Ensuite THIRD FLOOR -Bedroom 4: (2) Twin over Full Bunks  -Full Bath With Walk-in Shower **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels  WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Four parking spaces available (4 driveway). Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security. Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you're ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. AMENITY ACCESS In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas. BEACH ACCESS Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Capacity for 4 vehicles in the driveway. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a .
